_comment: Editorial content for FPRM. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. FPRM is a modaraba with operating business units, so those units and its financing products are listed.
description: First Paramount Modaraba is a non-banking Islamic financial institution — a listed modaraba — managed by Paramount Investments Limited. It takes deposits through certificates of musharakah and provides Shariah-compliant financing through musharakah, diminishing musharakah and murabaha, and runs business units covering consulting, solutions, petroleum services, geodynamics and anti-money-laundering services. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
